power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Yettḍurru s 0.5 deg tasint mi ara yili deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur  taceqquft tazeggaɣt d lmeḥna.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Yesserɣay tazmert s 30% s zzerb ɣef umdan.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: Taɣremt yetteddun n wuzzal d lebɣi  qrib ur tettḥerrik ara, maca d tarussint yerna tezmer ad tt-tḥaz uzɣal.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Ammesten ameɣlal I  asfeḍ n wuzzal n wuzzal ad yekkes tuyat ula ma ur yesɛi ara kra n ufecku.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Akatar ameqqran
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: Ur t-yettawi ara ssem, ur t-yettɣimi, ur t-yettawi laẓ.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: Iteddu s 25% s ttawil ɣef umdan amagnu.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Yettḍurru s ugar n 80% sɣur tmes, lavha, akked uguren n magma  uẓru yettawi azɣal.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Caveborn
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Yettuṛebba-d deg tillas  itett aẓru d azegzaw, itteffeẓ lmina s ifassen-is kan, maca yeqqur di tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Tiṭṭawin dduklent ɣer tillas  ulac taftilt i ilaqen. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: Yessen ad d-iṣubb ɣef lqaɛa ur nṣubb ara. Ur yettḍurru ara ma yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Yerẓa akk iḥedran s snat n tikkal n tɣawla  aẓru yefka-d i yifassen yettwassnen.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Ifassen-iw weḥd-sen d ayla-w am tkerrist n weblaḍ  ṛẓen lmizan d weblaḍ war ifecka.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: Ma yella ẓẓher yermed (yettunefk-d s wučči n uẓru), tiḥdayin n uẓru ad ɣlint amzun d Fortune II i d-yettwakksen.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Stone Eater
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Zemren ad ččen. cobblestone, stone, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, basalt, akked blackstone i tneččit yesɛan tizemmar. Ur ttuɣaleḍ ara deg uɛebbuḍ yeččuṛen.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Aɣṛum n yifungiyen
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: Iɣerdayen imcewwlen d imcewwlen d tiremt yelhan deg Nether  ssed s tqeffalt tayeffust akken ad teččeḍ 5 n laẓ d 0.6 n teččart. Ur teččeḍ ara s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Yezmer ad yečč tiɣbula n temẓin, temẓin tazeggaɣt, taẓruzt n temẓin, taẓruzt n temẓin tazeggaɣt, akked yiḥedran n temẓin tazeggaɣt  d tiremt fessusen gar weẓru d wuzzal. Ur yezmir ara ad yečč s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Aɛekkaz n wuzzal
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Yezmer ad yečč tiɣbula n wuzzal n wuzzal, tiɣbula n wuzzal, tiɣbula n wuzzal n wuzzal, tiɣbula n wuzzal n wuzzal n wuzzal, d yiḥedran n wuzzal n wuzzal  d tiremt yelhan i win yettnadin deg lmina. Ur yezmir ara ad yečč s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Aɛebbuḍ n uẓaṛ
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Tzemreḍ ad teččeḍ tiɣbula n ureɣ, ureɣ azegzaw, tiḥdayin n ureɣ, taḥdayt n ureɣ deepslate, taḥdayt n ureɣ n ddaw, akked yiḥedran n ureɣ azegzaw  d učči igerrzen. Ur teččeḍ ara s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Yezmer ad yečč almas, amẓin n almas, d umẓin n almas  am zṛuda n wureɣ ma yečč. Ur yettɣimi ara s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Yezmer ad yečč izemṛadiyen, amẓin n uzemṛadiyen, d umẓin n uzemṛadiyen  d tiremt tameqqrant ma ulac netherite. Ur yezmir ara ad yečč s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
Tzemreḍ ad teččeḍ tiɣbula n netherite, ifuras, d yiɣewwaren iqburen  tiremt tameṛkantit akk deg umaḍal. Ur teččeḍ ara s uɛebbuḍ yeččuren.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Mi ara teččeḍ lmeẓ, ad tesnuffseḍ aman i 60 n tsinin.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Učči n wuzzal yettak-d tazzla i 60 n tsinin.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Učči n wureɣ ad d-yefk arured i 2 n tesdatin.
Mi ara teččeḍ almas ad k-d-yefk ẓẓher II i 5 n tesdatin  ad tesremdeḍ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer tminewt n ẓẓher mi ara tili termed.
Mi ara teččeḍ azemṛad, ad teṭṭfeḍ 5 n ddqayeq deg tmes  tafat n yiṭij mazal-itt tesserɣay-ik, maca ur tezmir ara ad k-tesserɣ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Učči n netherite yettak-d Tazmert I akked Udem I i 5 n tesdatin.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Yettaṭṭaf times, yettḍurru 1 n tikelt deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% n teɣzi n umyurar amagnu  iẓekwan imecṭuḥen fessusen.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Silvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: Ṛṛuḥ n teẓgi taqburt  d arurad gar yisekla, ḥemmlen-t yiɣersiwen, yerna yezmer ad d-yesseḥlu acengu s uḥemmal n yiẓuran. D ageffur i t-yeḥlan, maca d Nether i t-yesserɣen.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Yiwen akked ugama
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Aṭas n yimdanen i d-yetteddun ad k-ǧǧen weḥd-k  ad d-rren ttar ma yella d kečč i d amezwaru.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Yettseḥlu s ttawil mi ara d-yeddu ɣer waman.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Yettnerni s tɣawla mi ara yili deg yibiyumen n teẓgi.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Yettawi 1 n lǧerḥ i tasint mi ara yili deg yibiyumen n Nether. Iceṭṭiḍen n Frost Walker ḥeṣlen akk i lǧerḥ.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: D idammen n yizem yerna yessexlaɛ-d  ur t-tettawi ara tmes yerna yessexlaɛ i yiɣersiwen, maca times n yizem tesserɣay s tɣawla s tezmert.
Ur t-tettḍurru ara tmes, lvawa, lmagma d tmes  idammen n yizmawen ḥman.
Yettɛummu deg laẓ s sshala am wiyaḍ deg waman.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: Yettban-d akken iwata deg lvawa, ur d-yettili ara wagu d wagu yerɣan  lqayen ur ffren acemma.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Tafesna n wafriwen
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Iferrawen n uẓeṭṭa ṛẓan-k mi ara teɣliḍ  ur yettḍurru ara win yeɣlin.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Tuget n yiɣersiwen ur nemɛin ara  aɣeṛsiw, imezdaɣ n taddart, iɣersiwen n lexla  ttazzalen ɣef tilin-ik taḥerfit.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: Asbeddi n teɣzi
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: Meqqer s 20% ɣef umyurar amagnu  yewɛer ad t-tzegleḍ.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Yettak-d 2 n wuguren niḍen deg yiwen n umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Yettḍurru s 1,5 deg tasint deg waman neɣ ageffur  times teḥwaǧ ad tesnuffes.
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.d: Yesseṛɣay tazmert s 50% s zzerb  times tesserɣay.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: Win ur nemmut ara yettruḥun deg tɣawsa yernu yettḍeyyiḍ-d  ur yezmir ara ad yeɣreq yerna ad iwali deg tillas, maca ad yeḥlu s ttawil, ad yerɣ deg tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Yettwaḥsab d ur nemmut ara. Yettwaḍurru s tezmert taskudant, yettwaḥlu s lexṣara taskudant, ur yettwaṭṭaf ara ssem.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Ur yeḥwaǧ ara ad yesnuffes. Yezmer ad yidir i lebda ddaw waman.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Yettaṭṭaf times, yettḍurru s 2 n tikkal deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Asnulfu n tdawsa tagamant yuder ɣer 40% n tannumi.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: Amecṭuḥ
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: Mecṭuḥ deg teɣzi, maca d arurad, d azrib  yettali kullec, yettawi-d tiɣawsiwin, maca yekkat am tfeṭṭift.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: Ameẓyan
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Tuṭṭfa n tjumma
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Yezmer ad yuli yal aɣrab s sshala.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Scurry
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Iteddu s 20% s zzerb ɣef umdan amagnu.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: D amecṭuḥ armi ur yesɛi ara azal ma yeɣli. Ur yettḍurru ara ma yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: Yettak-d 2 n wuguren drus deg yiwen n umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Aɛebbuḍ amecṭuḥ
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Yettɣawal laẓ s 80%  tfekka tamecṭuḥt tesserɣay učči s tɣawla.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Dragun n yifri
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: Azrem n tmes d weblaḍ, ilul-d deg lqay n ddunit. Yettnerni deg uzɣal d tillas, yerna yettimɣur s wakud.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Dragon n talɣa n yifri
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Awi talɣa n ujerriḥ n yifriw  d lxelq i d-yettmagma d tili. Iferdisen-ik·im n ujerriḥ, timerna-ik·im, d tzemmar-ik·im ttusefraken s usefrek n tezmert n ujerriḥ.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Dragun n teẓgi
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: Azrem n uẓar d usennan, deg uxxam-is gar yisekla iqburen. Yeṣber yerna yeṣber, simmal ittimɣur simmal yettimɣur.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: Dragon n talɣa n teẓgi
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Awi talɣa n udraku n teẓgi  d aɣersiw n tẓurin akked ssem. Ticeqqufin-ik·im n udraku, timerna-ik·im d tzemmar-ik·im ttusefrakent s usefrek n udraku.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Adragun n yilel
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: D azrem n tzizwit d tzawwa, ilul-d deg waman yeldin. D arurad ddaw lemwaji, yettaweḍ ɣer tezmert-is akk s leɛmeṛ.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Dragon s talɣa n yilel
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Err iman-ik deg udraku n yilel  d aɣersiw i d-yetteddun s uḥemmal d tmes. Ticeqqufin-ik·im n udraku, timerna-ik·im d tzemmar-ik·im ttusefrakent s usefrek n udraku.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Lwiyatan
